PA-007 Request Appointment: As a patient, I want to request a physical therapy appointment so that I can schedule a therapy session.
PA-001 Register	As a patient, I want to create an account so that I can access the system and request physical therapy appointments.
PA-002	Log In	As a patient, I want to log in to my account so that I can securely access my personal information and appointment features.
PA-003	Log Out	As a patient, I want to log out of my account so that I can protect my personal information from unauthorized access.
PA-004	View Profile	As a patient, I want to view my personal profile so that I can check whether my information is accurate.
PA-005	Edit Personal Information	As a patient, I want to edit my personal information so that my records remain accurate and up to date.
PA-006	Edit Contact Information	As a patient, I want to edit my contact information so that the clinic can reach me using my current contact details.
PA-009	View Pending Appointment Requests	As a patient, I want to view my pending appointment requests so that I can monitor requests that have not yet been processed.
PA-010	View Upcoming Appointments	As a patient, I want to view my upcoming appointments so that I know when I need to attend my next therapy session.
PA-011	View Previous Appointments	As a patient, I want to view my previous appointments so that I can keep track of my past appointments.
PA-012	Request Rescheduling	As a patient, I want to request a change to my appointment schedule so that I can request another suitable schedule when I am unavailable.
PA-013	View Assigned Therapist	As a patient, I want to view my assigned therapist so that I know which therapist will provide my therapy session.
PA-014	View Appointment Details	As a patient, I want to view my appointment details so that I can review the service, therapist, date, and time of my appointment.
PA-015	View Session History	As a patient, I want to view my previous therapy sessions so that I can keep track of my completed treatments.
PA-016	View Session Details	As a patient, I want to view the details of a completed therapy session so that I can review the date, duration, service, and general session notes available to me.
PA-017	Receive Appointment Notification	As a patient, I want to receive notifications about my appointments so that I am informed about important appointment updates.
PA-018	Receive Rescheduling Notification	As a patient, I want to receive a notification when my appointment is rescheduled so that I know about changes to my schedule.
PA-019	Receive Cancellation Notification	As a patient, I want to receive a notification when my appointment is cancelled so that I am aware that the appointment will no longer take place.
PA-020	Receive Upcoming Appointment Notification	As a patient, I want to receive reminders about upcoming appointments so that I do not forget my scheduled therapy session.

PA-021	Integrate Google Calendar	As a patient, I want my confirmed appointments to be integrated with Google Calendar so that I can easily view and manage my therapy schedule alongside my other activities.
TH-001	Log In	As a therapist, I want to log in to my account so that I can securely access my assigned functions.
TH-002	Log Out	As a therapist, I want to log out of my account so that I can protect my account from unauthorized access.
TH-003	View Profile	As a therapist, I want to view my professional profile so that I can check whether my information is accurate.
TH-004	Edit Profile	As a therapist, I want to edit my professional information so that my profile remains accurate and up to date.
TH-005	View Specialization	As a therapist, I want to view my recorded specialization so that I can verify the type of therapy services associated with my profile.
TH-006	Set Working Days	As a therapist, I want to set my available working days so that the admin can assign appointments based on my schedule.
TH-007	Set Working Hours	As a therapist, I want to set my available working hours so that the admin can avoid scheduling appointments outside my availability.
TH-008	View Assigned Appointments	As a therapist, I want to view my assigned appointments so that I know which patients I need to attend to.
TH-009	View Upcoming Appointments	As a therapist, I want to view my upcoming appointments so that I can prepare for my scheduled therapy sessions.
TH-010	View Previous Appointments	As a therapist, I want to view my previous appointments so that I can keep track of patients I have previously attended to.
TH-011	View Assigned Patients	As a therapist, I want to view my assigned patients so that I can prepare for their therapy sessions.
TH-012	View Patient Appointment Details	As a therapist, I want to view the appointment details of my assigned patients so that I know their scheduled service, date, and time.
TH-013	Request Rescheduling	As a therapist, I want to request an appointment reschedule when I am unavailable so that the admin can arrange a suitable alternative schedule.

TH-014	View Appointment Status	As a therapist, I want to view the status of my appointments so that I know whether they are pending, confirmed, rescheduled, completed, cancelled, or marked as no-show.
TH-015	Record Therapy Session	As a therapist, I want to record a completed therapy session so that the patient’s treatment activity is properly documented.
TH-016	Record Session Date	As a therapist, I want to record the date of a therapy session so that the patient’s treatment history contains the correct session date.
TH-017	Record Session Duration	As a therapist, I want to record the duration of a therapy session so that the patient’s session record accurately reflects the treatment time.
TH-018	Record Session Notes	As a therapist, I want to record general notes about a therapy session so that relevant treatment information is documented.
TH-019	Update Session Record	As a therapist, I want to update an existing session record so that incorrect or incomplete information can be corrected.
TH-020	View Session History	As a therapist, I want to view authorized previous session records so that I can review a patient’s therapy history.
TH-021	Integrate Google Calendar	As a therapist, I want my confirmed appointments to be integrated with Google Calendar so that I can manage my work schedule more conveniently.
TH-022	Mark Appointment as No-Show	As an therapist, I want to mark an appointment as no-show so that appointments that were not attended can be properly documented.
A-001	Admin Log In	As an admin, I want to log in to the system so that I can securely access administrative functions.
A-002	Admin Log Out	As an admin, I want to log out of the system so that I can protect the system from unauthorized access.
A-003	Add User	As an admin, I want to add a user account so that authorized patients, therapists, and secretaries can access the system.
A-004	View User	As an admin, I want to view user account information so that I can monitor registered users.
A-005	Edit User	As an admin, I want to edit user account information so that user records remain accurate and up to date.
A-006	Archive User	As an admin, I want to archive a user account so that inactive accounts can be retained without allowing them to appear as active users.
A-008	Activate User	As an admin, I want to activate a user account so that an authorized user can access the system.
A-009	Deactivate User	As an admin, I want to deactivate a user account so that a user can temporarily be prevented from accessing the system.
A-010	Manage Patient Information	As an admin, I want to manage patient information so that patient records remain accurate and complete.
A-011	Manage Therapist Information	As an admin, I want to manage therapist information so that therapist records remain accurate and complete.
A-012	Manage Therapist Specialization	As an admin, I want to record and update therapist specializations so that patients can be assigned to appropriate therapists.
A-013	Manage Therapist Working Days	As an admin, I want to manage therapist working days so that appointments can be scheduled according to therapist availability.
A-014	Manage Therapist Working Hours	As an admin, I want to manage therapist working hours so that appointment schedules do not conflict with therapist availability.
A-015	Add Therapy Service	As an admin, I want to add a therapy service so that patients can request available physical therapy services.
A-016	Edit Therapy Service	As an admin, I want to edit therapy service information so that service details remain accurate.
A-017	Archive Therapy Service	As an admin, I want to remove a therapy service so that unavailable services are no longer offered to patients.
A-018	Set Service Duration	As an admin, I want to set the duration of a therapy service so that appointments can be scheduled with the correct treatment duration.
A-019	Set Service Fee	As an admin, I want to set the fee of a therapy service so that the correct payment amount can be recorded.
A-020	Receive Appointment Request	As an admin, I want to receive appointment requests so that I can review and process patient requests.
A-021	Review Appointment Request	As an admin, I want to review an appointment request so that I can determine whether an appropriate schedule and therapist are available.
A-022	Assign Therapist	As an admin, I want to assign a therapist to an appointment so that the patient can be attended to by an appropriate therapist.
A-023	Confirm Appointment	As an admin, I want to confirm an appointment so that the patient and therapist have an official appointment schedule.
A-024	Reschedule Appointment	As an admin, I want to reschedule an appointment so that a suitable alternative schedule can be provided when necessary.
A-025	Cancel Appointment	As an admin, I want to cancel an appointment so that the appointment record accurately reflects that the session will not proceed.
A-026	Mark Appointment as Completed	As an admin, I want to mark an appointment as completed so that completed appointments are properly recorded.
A-027	Mark Appointment as No-Show	As an admin, I want to mark an appointment as no-show so that appointments that were not attended can be properly documented.
A-028	View Upcoming Appointments	As an admin, I want to view upcoming appointments so that I can monitor the clinic’s schedule.
A-029	View Previous Appointments	As an admin, I want to view previous appointments so that I can review completed or past appointment records.
A-030	View Appointment History	As an admin, I want to view appointment history so that I can monitor the clinic’s appointment records.
A-031	View Session History	As an admin, I want to view session history so that I can monitor patient therapy records.
A-032	Manage Payment Status	As an admin, I want to manage the payment status of an appointment so that the system accurately reflects whether a service has been paid.
A-033	Mark Payment as Paid	As an admin, I want to mark an appointment payment as paid so that completed payments are properly recorded.
A-034	Mark Payment as Unpaid	As an admin, I want to mark an appointment payment as unpaid so that outstanding payments can be identified.
A-035	View Payment Status	As an admin, I want to view payment statuses so that I can monitor paid and unpaid appointments.
A-036	Search Patient Records	As an admin, I want to search patient records so that I can quickly find a specific patient.
A-037	Search Therapist Records	As an admin, I want to search therapist records so that I can quickly find a specific therapist.
A-038	Search Appointment Records	As an admin, I want to search appointment records so that I can quickly find specific appointments.
A-039	Filter Records	As an admin, I want to filter records so that I can quickly identify information based on specific criteria.
A-040	View Patient Count Report	As an admin, I want to view the number of registered patients so that I can monitor the clinic’s patient population.
A-041	View Completed Session Report	As an admin, I want to view the number of patients who completed therapy sessions within a selected period so that I can monitor completed treatments.
A-042	View Appointment Report	As an admin, I want to view appointment statistics so that I can monitor the number and status of appointments within a selected period.
A-043	View Therapist Workload Report	As an admin, I want to view the number of appointments assigned to each therapist so that I can monitor therapist workload and scheduling.
A-044	View Payment Report	As an admin, I want to view payment reports so that I can monitor paid and unpaid therapy services.
A-045	View Clinic Summary Report	As an admin, I want to view a summary of clinic activities so that I can monitor overall clinic operations.
A-046	Send Appointment Notification	As an admin, I want the system to send appointment notifications so that patients and therapists are informed about appointment updates.
A-047 Review Therapist Request reschedule and Approve, I want the system to allow the admin to view and approve reschedules of appointments.
SE-001	Secretary Log In	As a secretary, I want to log in to the system so that I can securely access my assigned functions.
SE-002	Secretary Log Out	As a secretary, I want to log out of the system so that I can protect the system from unauthorized access.
SE-003	View Profile	As a secretary, I want to view my profile so that I can verify my account information.
SE-004	Edit Profile	As a secretary, I want to edit my profile information so that my account details remain accurate.
SE-005	View Upcoming Schedule	As a secretary, I want to view the clinic’s upcoming appointment schedule so that I can assist with daily clinic operations.
SE-006	View Appointment Details	As a secretary, I want to view appointment details so that I can provide accurate scheduling information when assisting patients and staff.
SE-007	Search Appointment Schedule	As a secretary, I want to search the appointment schedule so that I can quickly find a patient’s upcoming appointment.
SE-008	Record Payment	As a secretary, I want to record a patient’s payment so that the patient’s payment transaction is properly documented.
SE-009	Update Payment Status	As a secretary, I want to update the payment status after receiving payment so that the system accurately reflects the patient’s payment record.
SE-010	View Payment Status	As a secretary, I want to view payment status so that I can determine whether an appointment has been paid or remains unpaid.
SE-011	View Patient Appointment Information	As a secretary, I want to view relevant appointment information so that I can assist patients with their scheduled appointments.
